name: ready
description: Backlog: an agent can pick this up now (AGENTS.md §Backlog)

name: claimed
description: Backlog: a live claim or an open PR holds it — set by fleet-board.mjs

name: blocked
description: Backlog: waits on another issue (say which: Blocked by #n)

name: epic
description: Parent issue: the work is in its sub-issues

name: fleet-board
description: The pinned board issue, rewritten hourly by fleet.yml

name: flaky
description: A test that passes on retry or fails across branches; the daily flake-tally issue (AGENTS.md rule 9)

name: base-red
description: A spec failing first-try on unrelated branches: a red on the base (flake-tally.yml, advisory)

name: run-ci
description: Draft PR: run CI fast tier (guards, node suites, parts census, driving-model; no browser specs)

name: land
description: PR: the worker asks GitHub to land it — land.yml runs the gate check and arms auto-merge

name: hold
description: PR: do not land; whoever set it removes it (Bryce always can). Replaces MERGE-HOLD:

name: needs-owner
description: PR: no live worker (silent 2 h, 6 h for lane:codex, or the cost cap) — the dispatcher relaunches

name: needs-decision
description: Issue or PR: waits on a decision only Bryce can make; the options are in a comment

name: priority
description: Bryce's one steering word: the dispatcher launches or lands this first

name: lane:claude
description: PR: a Claude cloud session owns it (the full worker contract, docs/WORKERS.md)

name: lane:cursor
description: PR: a Cursor cloud agent owns it; the dispatcher sets run-ci and land on its behalf

name: lane:codex
description: PR: a Codex thread owns it (pull-only, Bryce's tool); re-owned after 6 h of silence

name: dispatch:pause
description: Dispatch issue: the dispatcher launches nothing while this is set

name: dispatch:merge-pause
description: Dispatch issue: land.yml and the dispatcher arm nothing while this is set

name: deploy:red
description: Board issue: pages.yml's latest run failed on the tip; one fixer is launched

name: bug
description: Something isn't working

name: area:physics
description: Handling, grip, pace (skill tune-physics)

name: area:ai
description: AI racecraft and driver personality (skill ai-racecraft)

name: area:track
description: Circuits, geometry, scenery (skills new-track, scenery-dress, survey-track)

name: area:render
description: TLX / GLX / WGX renderers, lighting, assets (skills renderer-debug, lighting-tuner)

name: area:ui
description: Menus, HUD, a11y, phone layout (skills ui-menu-a11y, css-play)

name: area:career
description: Career, season, strategy (skills career-mode, season-mode)

name: area:race
description: Race control, incidents, flags, broadcast and replay cameras

name: area:audio
description: Engine, sfx, music (skill audio-debug)

name: area:net
description: Multiplayer, data hub, PWA (skills multiplayer-debug, data-hub, pwa-cache-service-worker)

name: area:perf
description: Frame time, memory, download weight

name: area:tooling
description: tools/, tests, CI, agent kit (skills check-changes, steward, slim-bloat)
